content_html:
Latest episode

No. 5 Aug 16, 2026 4:48

Peace Talks, Ocean Heat, and AI Teams

Sam and Leah explain a proposal for talks between South and North Korea, NOAA’s strengthening El Niño outlook, what a careful health-study result does and does not show, and why teams of AI helpers need checks.

In this episode

  • 0:01 Opening and preview
  • 0:16 South Korea peace-talk proposal
  • 1:04 NOAA El Niño outlook
  • 2:03 Health study risk signal
  • 3:18 AI helper teams
  • 4:17 Recap and closing question

Open episode page →

What is MyFirst.News?

MyFirst.News is a daily news podcast for curious kids. Sam and Leah explain important true stories in about ten minutes—clearly, factually, and without graphic detail. Every episode ends with a question to discuss together. Grown-ups can read how it’s made.

Recent episodes

  • No. 4 Aug 15, 2026 6:27

    Earthquakes, Rainforests, and Locked Data

    Sam and Leah explain a powerful earthquake in Indonesia, an operation against illegal gold mining in Peru, a French court decision about social media, Google’s encrypted-data tool, and a health response in Myanmar.

  • No. 3 Aug 14, 2026 5:49

    Flights, Oil, and Shooting Stars

    Sam and Leah explain the C919 passenger jet’s first international flight, an oil slick on Iran’s coast, hot weather in parts of Europe, and the Perseid meteor shower. They separate what is confirmed from what people are still checking.

  • No. 2 Aug 13, 2026 9:38

    Votes, Trains, and a Black Hole Star

    Sam and Leah follow a planned coalition withdrawal from Iraq, Zambia’s election count, a train derailment near Lewes, a possible black-hole-star model, and Nine PBS’s effort to recover its archive. They ask how evidence changes when a plan, count, investigation, or recovery is still underway.

什么是 MyFirst.News？

MyFirst.News 是为好奇的孩子们准备的每日新闻播客。 萨姆和利亚在大约十分钟内清晰、真实地解释了重要的真实故事，没有任何图形细节。 每集都以一个共同讨论的问题结束。 大人可以阅读它的制作方法。

最近剧集

  • 第 4 期 2026 年 8 月 15 日 6:27 地震、雨林和锁定数据 Sam 和 Leah 解释了印度尼西亚的一场强烈地震、秘鲁打击非法金矿的行动、法国法院关于社交媒体的裁决、谷歌的加密数据工具以及缅甸的健康应对措施。
  • 2026 年 8 月 14 日 3 日 5:49 航班、石油和流星 Sam 和 Leah 介绍了 C919 客机的首次国际航班、伊朗海岸的浮油、欧洲部分地区的炎热天气以及英仙座流星雨。 他们将已确认的内容与人们仍在检查的内容分开。
  • 2026 年 8 月 13 日 9:38 选票、火车和黑洞星 Sam 和 Leah 报道了联盟计划从伊拉克撤军、赞比亚选举计票、刘易斯附近的火车出轨、可能的黑洞星模型以及 9 号 PBS 恢复档案的努力。 他们询问当计划、计数、调查或恢复仍在进行时，证据会发生怎样的变化。
